profile.headline: Software Developer | Packaging Engineer | Pursuer of Knowledge | Video Game Enthusiast | Nature Lover
profile.summary:
With a solid foundation in packaging experience and an unyielding passion for technology, I am embarking on an exciting journey into the world of software development.  My background in packaging has provided me with valuable insights into problem-solving, attention to detail, and the importance of efficient processes. Now, I am thrilled to channel my passion for technology and embark on a new path that merges my expertise in packaging with cutting-edge software solutions.

My transition into software development has been driven by a desire to explore the boundless possibilities of technology and its transformative impact on industries worldwide. I have actively immersed myself in programming languages, software design principles, and cutting-edge frameworks to equip myself with the tools necessary to thrive in this dynamic field. Embracing every opportunity to learn and grow, I am determined to contribute my unique perspective and problem-solving acumen to create innovative software solutions that drive efficiency and enhance user experiences.

As I delve into this exciting new chapter, I am eager to collaborate with like-minded professionals and organizations to embark on projects that push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. I am confident that my adaptable mindset and diverse background will prove to be valuable assets in the ever-evolving landscape of software development. Let's connect and explore ways we can work together to create transformative software solutions that shape a brighter and more connected future.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description:
Recent graduate of Tech Elevator's Java coding bootcamp. Below is a list of projects I've completed or am currently working on:
Meal Planner Application
- Developed a full stack application with a group of fellow software developers that utilizes Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, HTLM, CSS, and Vue.js to store and display meal planning information.

Tenmo Application
-Crafted a digital currency application using Java, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL that utilizes API endpoints.

Vending Machine Application
- Worked as a team with fellow software developers to create a virtual vending machine that utilized object oriented Java programming. The vending machine application allows the user to display the items within the machine, adds money based on their input, and dispenses their selected item.
positions.insights: Skills: Time Management · Full-Stack Development · Agile Methodologies · PostgreSQL · Table Design · Vue.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · intellij · Software Development · Integration Testing · Spring Boot · E/R diagrams · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · Unit Testing · SQL · Front-End Development · Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) · JavaScript · Java · Git

positions.title: Packaging Engineer
positions.description:
-Engineered packaging solutions ensuring safe, damage-free delivery to Lowe’s, Home Depot, and Walmart, meeting retailer requirements and protecting brand reputation
-Partnered with cross-functional teams (5+ groups including design, manufacturing, and logistics) to complete projects on time and align packaging with supply chain needs
-Redesigned packaging to eliminate 100% of plastic materials, creating sustainable, cost-effective solutions that aligned with corporate sustainability goals
positions.insights: Skills: Time Management · Problem Solving · Adobe Illustrator · Manufacturing · Packaging Design · SAP · Tops · Teamwork · Communication · Testing · Project Management · Packaging Machinery · Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · Packaging Engineering

positions.title: Technical Support/Field Operator
positions.description:
- Aided in the transitioning the company to a new management platform to create a streamlined on-boarding system for new properties as well as a place to house company and property information, resulting in a 30% improved operational efficiency
- Helped in managing a portfolio of over 30 rental vacation home properties while also assisting in training and onboarding of new employees

positions.title: Food Server
positions.description:
- Demonstrated ability to multitask efficiently while maintaining a positive attitude in high-pressure situations.
- Proficient in POS systems, accurately processing orders, and handling transactions.
- Proactive in anticipating guest needs and providing personalized recommendations.
- Collaborative team player, adept at working with colleagues to ensure seamless dining experiences.
- Committed to upholding food safety standards and maintaining a clean and organized work environment.
